title: Reduced perturbation initialization with weighted 400-550 nm spectral loss
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing optimizer perturbation amplitude from ±20 nm to ±10 nm while seeding from the iteration_06 best candidate thickness vector will enable finer convergence in the thickness discontinuity zone, and applying weighted loss prioritizing 400-550 nm sub-band will decouple coupled resonance modes that limit visible reflection uniformity.
design_principle: Local refinement around a known high-performing configuration with spectrally-weighted optimization to disentangle overlapping interference modes in the short-wavelength visible band.
proposed_topology: exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers)
design_variables: All 30 layer thicknesses, initialized from iteration_06 candidate opt_hfo2_sio2_30l_chirp_hpfs__grad__226e03faf954 thickness vector with ±10 nm perturbation bounds
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band with 2x weight on 400-550 nm sub-band
manufacturing_considerations: Individual layer thicknesses should remain within 40-200 nm range for deposition feasibility
theory_basis: Weighted spectral optimization for mode decoupling
Local refinement around known optima reduces search space dimensionality
expected_advantages: Finer convergence in thickness space near known high-performing configuration
Improved 400-550 nm reflection uniformity through weighted loss
Reduced risk of escaping the 0.940 score basin while exploring local improvements
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum if perturbation is too small
Weighted loss may degrade 550-700 nm performance if coupling is beneficial
30-layer count may be near fabrication complexity limit
execution_request_english: Optimize a 30-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at normal angle. Layer sequence: HfO2(1), SiO2(2), HfO2(3), SiO2(4), ... ending with SiO2(30) adjacent to substrate. Initialize all 30 layer thicknesses from the vector [58.555, 88.888, 54.609, 89.507, 56.204, 98.173, 64.725, 103.146, 62.059, 90.830, 124.964, 86.427, 56.472, 88.946, 121.912, 93.736, 63.099, 176.938, 178.127, 155.323, 119.593, 177.959, 161.513, 88.070, 163.472, 175.203, 117.158, 175.673, 153.443, 132.308] nm with optimization bounds of ±10 nm from each initial value. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Spectral objective: maximize transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band, maximize reflectance in 400-700 nm band with 2.0x weight applied to 400-550 nm sub-band relative to 550-700 nm sub-band. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized or both s and p polarization averaged. Topology realization override: disregard any symbolic repeat count, range, or ellipsis above and use exactly 6 alternating HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers). Optimize only continuous physical thicknesses; the task compiler must fully expand every finite layer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1530–1565 nm; high reflection in 400–700 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1530–1565 nm; transmission in 400–700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 30.
revision_reason: Follows feedback directive to reduce perturbation amplitude by 50% and apply weighted spectral loss to decouple resonance modes in 400-550 nm sub-band
